Swift Prepaid Solutions (BCV's listing 2019-2022, Growth, Matt Harris): 'Syncapay, a new holding company focused on high-potential payments solutions has launched with the backing of Bain Capital Ventures, Silversmith Capital Partners, MissionOG, Nyca Partners' and 'Syncapay's first acquisition, Swift Prepaid Services, was made late last year' (PR Newswire, Dallas, 2018-05-02). BCV's money reached Swift through a holding company its investor group formed to buy the business outright; renamed daVinci Payments (2019) and merged into Onbe on Centerbridge's majority investment (2020). OPEN for Erik: the release does not state the group's share of Syncapay; if BCV held a minority stake in Syncapay, the row is a member under the holding company's name. A control acquisition is not a venture round (COLLECTION.md s1 T3 control positions; decisions.md D4): the firm with its co-investor group took 50% or more.
